title: 086_SDV_Synthetic_Data_Vault
summary: A Jupyter notebook demo exercise that fits a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on tabular data, defines its metadata schema, and evaluates the synthetic output's quality and diagnostics. The notebook directly runs SDV's single-table synthesis API alongside SDMetrics' quality reporting to generate and assess synthetic data.
evidence: SDV_demo.ipynb: 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)' followed by fit/sample and evaluate_quality calls
